prompt: Who is the only female artist to have topped Spotify's list of most-streamed artists in three consecutive years (2020–2022)?
answer: None. **Bad Bunny** topped Spotify’s global most-streamed-artist list from **2020–2022**; **Taylor Swift** is the only female artist to top it, doing so in **2023 and 2024**, not three consecutive years.
